title: "The path in the environment variable AMENT_PREFIX_PATH doesn't exist" in colcon build: stale sourced paths, re-sourcing and the fixes, measured
excerpt: Why colcon warns about missing AMENT_PREFIX_PATH, CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH and COLCON_PREFIX_PATH entries after you delete install, remove a package or move a workspace, why re-sourcing in the same terminal keeps the stale path, and which fixes cleared it on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
